stories.headline: Trumbull leaf pickup starts Nov. 4 — track progress on the town map
stories.summary: Trumbull Public Works announced Wednesday details for the 2026 loose-leaf collection program, which is expected to begin Nov. 4 and run until every neighborhood is cleared. Equipment will be tested the week before, weather can delay routes, and residents can follow a daily-updated leaf pickup progress map on the town site. Bagged leaf pickup can also be requested as often as needed during the season.

stories.headline: MAGA-aligned PACs dump $163M into ads — much of it defending deep-red districts
stories.summary: Three Trump-aligned groups — MAGA Inc., No Going Back PAC and Safety and Affordability PAC — have spent more than $163 million on ads since Sept. 1, with nearly 40% going to states and districts Trump won by 10 points or more in 2024, an AP AdImpact analysis found. Republicans are flush with cash but glum about gas prices, the Iran war, and midterm headwinds as some candidates distance themselves from White House policies.

stories.headline: CNN, Politico, MS NOW face Trump admin in court over White House media ban
stories.summary: CNN, Politico and MS NOW argued Wednesday before Trump-appointed Judge Timothy Kelly that their White House expulsion is unconstitutional viewpoint discrimination. DOJ says access is a “privilege,” citing alleged falsehoods and sensitive reporting; Trump called the ban an assault on “FAKE NEWS” and vowed to appeal if he loses. More than four dozen media groups filed an amicus brief urging the ban be lifted.

stories.headline: Judge orders ICE-shot Venezuelan delivery driver to appear Sept. 30 as video emerges
stories.summary: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, was back in ICE detention with a bullet still in his back after an Austin shooting by a federal immigration officer, his attorney said. A federal judge ordered him to appear Sept. 30 in San Antonio as lawyers seek to block removal; Austin police released body-cam showing him wounded in his car after a DoorDash delivery encounter that sparked Capitol protests.

stories.headline: Tesla rolls out in-car Grok Connectors for email, calendar, and files
stories.summary: Tesla expanded Grok inside vehicles with Connectors that let drivers manage inbox, calendar, and files hands-free by voice. Agent-style tasks such as coffee orders and restaurant bookings are currently limited to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers, with broader tiers promised later. The update follows Grok 4.7’s release and builds on recent in-car browsing and messaging features.

stories.headline: Apple ships iOS 27 with Siri AI, stronger Screen Time, and Liquid Glass tweaks
stories.summary: Apple’s major platform updates are rolling out across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and more, led by Siri AI — a more conversational assistant with personal context and onscreen awareness, launching as an English beta. Parents get redesigned Screen Time and Ask to Browse controls, while Photos, Safari, and performance upgrades land systemwide. Some Apple Intelligence features carry daily usage limits and regional restrictions.

stories.headline: LEGO Batman Returns Batmobile: 2,269 pieces with button-reveal Batmissile
stories.summary: The LEGO Group unveiled set 76355, a 2,269-piece recreation of the Tim Burton Batman Returns Batmobile with a first-of-its-kind button that splits the body to reveal a hidden Batmissile escape vehicle. The $229.99 adult display set includes six Easter eggs, three new elements, and an exclusive Batman minifigure with a newly moulded cape. Insiders early access began Sept. 1; general sale followed Sept. 4.

stories.headline: Jets Stock Report: No. 1 defense and Bailey’s pressures head into Lions week
stories.summary: Despite a 20–17 OT loss to Green Bay, the Jets rank No. 1 in total defense through two games, allowing the fewest yards and first downs in the NFL. Rookie edge David Bailey already has two sacks and rare early-career pressure rates, while safeties Andre Cisco and Dane Belton have locked down the middle since Minkah Fitzpatrick’s injury. Next up: a reeling Detroit Lions defense ranked last in yards and points allowed.

stories.headline: Ruck twins share ‘pretty special’ Penguins preseason debut on the same line
stories.summary: 2026 draft picks Liam (No. 22) and Markus Ruck (No. 39) debuted together for Pittsburgh against Detroit, skating on the same line in a 7–4 preseason loss. Coach Dan Muse praised their camp progress; Markus only got in after Ville Koivunen’s injury. The Medicine Hat WHL stars — nearly identical off the ice — called sharing an NHL jersey with Crosby and Malkin nearby a lifelong dream.

stories.headline: Bullet For My Valentine: Dimebag’s Vulgar Display tone is the ‘most iconic’ ever
stories.summary: In a resurfaced MusicRadar interview, Matt Tuck named Pantera’s Vulgar Display of Power as the most iconic guitar tone of all time — “crushing… honky and scooped,” with lead tones so individual “no-one else sounded like that.” Tuck argued Dimebag’s identity lived in his hands: give someone else the same guitar and amp and it “would sound like dogs**t.” The piece also covers BFMV’s simpler Gravity-era tracking approach.

stories.headline: Jeep and Harley-Davidson reunite communities at European Bike Week 2026
stories.summary: Jeep and Harley-Davidson highlighted their renewed European partnership at Faaker See’s European Bike Week, showcasing Avenger 4xe and Compass hybrids with test drives for riders and Jeep fans. The 2014-born collaboration was refreshed for 2026 events that organizers say have reached up to 200,000 participants. Autumn stops continue with Ladies of Harley in Pescara (Oct. 3) and a H.O.G. Winter Meeting in Genoa (Nov. 28).

stories.headline: Erika Kirk marks Charlie’s death anniversary: ‘Until heaven’
stories.summary: On the first anniversary of Charlie Kirk’s Sept. 10, 2025 assassination, Erika Kirk posted a black-and-white wedding photo with the caption “… Until heaven.” She continues as Turning Point USA CEO; accused gunman Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty and is due back in court Oct. 23. The family thanked supporters and said they remain committed to justice and a transparent process.

stories.headline: Dr. Amy J.L. Baker: parental alienation is unjustified rejection — not estrangement
stories.summary: Developmental psychologist Amy J.L. Baker defines parental alienation as one parent’s behaviors fostering a child’s unjustified rejection of the other parent — distinct from estrangement after real abuse. She outlines 17 alienating strategies, urges targeted parents to show up calmly and document contact, and compares unseen nurturing to planting a winter bulb that may bloom later. The free episode also covers coaching and court-facing documentation habits.

stories.headline: Free USA foliage map ranks peak color for every county, park, and forest
stories.summary: Filmmakers Will and Jim Pattiz launched a free More Than Just Parks Foliage Map covering all 3,104 lower-48 counties plus 1,600+ public lands, including every national park and forest with enough canopy to forecast. Enter a ZIP and weekend to rank nearby peaks, spot dual-peak forests (aspen then larch), and check live cameras and reservation flags before you drive. The model updates daily with weather and ground reports.
